SuperlevelBar.lean remains 3 defs + 1 abbrev + 20 theorems = 24 targets, as stated.

This is a count transcription error only — not a proof defect. Both module verdicts (**PASS, source-scoped**), all stated limits (no Lean execution by me, FORMAL HOLD intact), and the original review are otherwise unchanged and preserved additively.

**Pickup release:** my bounded source-read pickup (6116159578) is now explicitly **released**. The read is complete; no further claims held.
